content.title: Knowledge of Druids
content.body:
On my journey, I stumbled upon an imposing tower. There was an unmistakable aura about it, a sense that it was aware of me. As I drew near, glowing wisps sprung up, lighting the way forward as if to welcome me.

The ascent was tough, but I reached the summit.

At the top, I found an ancient, dust-covered book detailing the lore of a people known as the Druids. It's clear now that a society once thrived here, a revelation that fills me with wonder and a hint of dread. What became of them, these predecessors, and what does their absence mean for our safety?

I need to pore over this tome, to absorb its secrets and understand more about this land.
